Internal helper: the stop on a cross-tabulation variable with more than 20 values

Source: R/compare.R
dot-jst_crosstab_values_cap.Rd

A variable measured on a scale and cross-tabulated by mistake – jcrosstab( Age ~ Sex) – printed a table of one row per age (the large-crosstab item, built Session 375 at the lean of 20). Past 20 values the call stops, naming each such variable and its count (several in one stop, voice Rule AJ), with the call that tabulates it anyway: the call as typed with categorical = naming it, so it runs as printed.

Usage

.jst_crosstab_values_cap(levels_list, names, cat_names, call, cap = 20L)

Arguments

levels_list

List of the two variables' categories.

names

Character(2); the variables.

cat_names

Character; the variables categorical = names.

call

The call, from sys.call().

cap

Integer; the most values a variable may have.

Value

Invisible NULL, or stops.
